activeApp.name: Coral Companion
activeApp.tagline: Your ultimate companion for Coral Island.
activeApp.summary: A free companion app for the farming sim Coral Island. Track museum donations, altar offerings, shipped items, and farm upgrades, browse an interactive island map and full field guide, and manage relationships and birthdays — all offline, with dark mode.
features: Full field guide: items, townsfolk, recipes, shops, upgrades
